answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making reputation grow only along verified work, like a vine climbing a trellis. Each newcomer locks collateral, accepts unpredictable tasks, and collects attestations from reviewers outside its cluster. A willow ledger bends with fresh evidence but keeps every signature, while a terrace of graduated tiers gates influence behind sustained accuracy. Audits slash faked bonds, so mass identities add cost and exposure without adding trust.
